stem: Why does the poet compare space travelers to the early settlers of America?
instruction:
Read lines 11 and 12 from the poem.

They will have perils to meet, but they will meet them,
As the early settlers did on American shores.

options.label: A
options.text: To highlight the difficulties that the early settlers encountered when venturing into new places

options.label: B
options.text: To imply that the obstacles the early settlers faced discouraged them from exploring new lands

options.label: C
options.text: To suggest that explorers will overcome the difficulties in space just as explorers in the past overcame their difficulties

options.label: D
options.text: To demonstrate that explorers will encounter the same challenges in space as explorers in the past did in other frontiers

visual_elements:
They will have perils to meet, but they will meet them,
As the early settlers did on American shores.
